description: Audits Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins, Schema Admins, and Administrators groups for stale accounts, service accounts with admin rights, and disabled accounts still holding privileged group membership. Generates proposed remediation CRs.

parameters.name: stale_threshold_days
parameters.description: Number of days without logon before an account is considered stale

parameters.name: include_groups
parameters.description: Which privileged groups to audit (default: all four)

parameters.name: generate_remediations
parameters.description: Whether to generate proposed remediation CRs for risky accounts
